Farm-fresh dairy, one clear journey.

A website for a dairy brand serving Jalandhar, presenting its milk and ghee range, delivery options and subscription plans.

Puramilk Health

01 / The project

What it is

Puramilk Health is a dairy website that introduces the brand and its milk and ghee range. It brings product information, delivery coverage, subscription plans and booking entry points together for customers arranging regular deliveries.

The main audience is households in Jalandhar looking for dairy delivery. The site also distinguishes the wider shipping option for ghee, so customers can understand which products are available in their area.

02 / The challenge

What it needs to solve

A recurring delivery involves more decisions than choosing a product. Customers also need to understand quantity, frequency, delivery arrangements and the differences between plans before starting a booking.

03 / Design thinking

The approach

The product range is presented alongside pricing and availability information. Delivery explanations and frequently asked questions support the decision, while the brand story gives context without replacing practical ordering details.

Daily, alternate-day and custom subscription options give customers a way to compare schedules. The quick-booking entry point starts with a product and a preferred date, keeping the first step focused.

04 / The experience

How it works

  1. Explore the range

    Compare the milk options and ghee, checking the information and availability shown for each product.

  2. Choose a routine

    Review the subscription schedules and delivery information to find an option that fits the household.

  3. Begin the booking

    Select a product and preferred date, then continue towards the fuller booking details.

The aim is to make regular dairy delivery easier to understand, with product choice, service coverage and scheduling explained before customers begin a booking.
